newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST - Swedish GDP seen up 1.6 pct in Q1 '97.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Swedish GDP seen up 1.6 pct in Q1 '97.

text.p: Swedish gross domestic product (GDP) was expected to rise 1.6 percent in the first quarter of 1997, a Reuters poll of 13 analysts showed.
The forecasts ranged from 0.5 percent to three percent.
For the full-year 1997 GDP is expected to rise by 2.2 percent on average, with the forecasts ranging from 1.6 percent to 2.8 percent.
GDP rose 1.8 percent in the fourth quarter of 1997 and in the first quarter of 1996, 1.4 percent.
Statistics Sweden is due to publish the figure at 1100 GMT on June 11.

Sources for this survey were analysts from: Aragon, Carnegie, Den Danske Bank, Hagstromer & Qviberg, Handelbanken, JP Morgan, Lehman Brothers, Penser, S-E-Banken, Transferator, UBS, Unibank and Ohman.
